_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the spawned tests that drive the guard's exit code.

expectRed: blocks a production edit after a review round until plan-critic is dispatched
sets the lock when a gate-round agent is dispatched
sets the lock when a conditional agent is dispatched
sets the lock again when the next round dispatches a reviewer
blocks a production target reached through an exempt directory via ..
blocks a production file whose path contains apps/web/e2e/ below another directory
blocks a production edit in any worktree under .claude/worktrees while locked
allows a root .coderabbit.yaml edit but blocks a nested one while armed
blocks an armed edit when the hook runs from an agent worktree copy
mutations.note: Forces the block helper to exit 0 instead of 2 — the reason is printed but the edit is no longer blocked.

expectRed: allows any edit when no gate state exists
clears the lock when plan-critic is dispatched after a round
mutations.note: The early no-lock return blocks instead of allowing — an edit with no lock is refused.

expectRed: sets the lock when a gate-round agent is dispatched
sets the lock when a conditional agent is dispatched
sets the lock again when the next round dispatches a reviewer
sets the lock beside the hook when git cannot resolve the repo
mutations.note: A gate-round or conditional dispatch writes no lock — the round never locks edits.

expectRed: clears the lock when plan-critic is dispatched after a round
mutations.note: A plan-critic dispatch leaves the lock in place — edits stay blocked.

expectRed: allows a production file outside the repo root when the gate is armed
mutations.note: A path outside the repo root (a scratch clone) is checked like a production file.

expectRed: allows a spec.ts edit under apps/web/e2e/ even when the gate is armed
mutations.note: Removes the apps/web/e2e/ allowance — a spec edit under apps/web/e2e/ is blocked again while the gate is armed, even though e2e-writer/red-team need to write there.

expectRed: blocks a production target reached through an exempt directory via ..
mutations.note: Removes path normalization — the raw path still starts with the apps/web/e2e/ directory, so the exemption lets a production target through.

expectRed: blocks a production file whose path contains apps/web/e2e/ below another directory
blocks a production edit in any worktree under .claude/worktrees while locked
blocks an armed edit when the hook runs from an agent worktree copy
mutations.note: Matches an exempt directory anywhere in the path instead of under its checkout root — <root>/vendor/apps/web/e2e/x.ts, and any worktree file under .claude/, is let through.

expectRed: blocks a production edit in any worktree under .claude/worktrees while locked
blocks an armed edit when the hook runs from an agent worktree copy
mutations.note: Drops the worktree carve-out — a production file inside .claude/worktrees/ passes as an exempt .claude path.

expectRed: allows a docs edit inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is armed
mutations.note: Denies every exemption inside a worktree — the worktree's own docs/, .claude/ and apps/web/e2e/ files are blocked.

expectRed: allows a root .coderabbit.yaml edit but blocks a nested one while armed
mutations.note: No file exemption — the .coderabbit.yaml edit coderabbit-sync requires is blocked while armed.

expectRed: allows a root .coderabbit.yaml edit but blocks a nested one while armed
mutations.note: Matches an exempt file name anywhere — a nested vendor/.coderabbit.yaml passes.

expectRed: blocks an armed edit when the hook runs from an agent worktree copy
mutations.note: The root comes from the hook's own location — a worktree copy of the hook looks for the lock in the worktree and finds none.

expectRed: leaves the state unchanged when a non-gate agent is dispatched
mutations.note: Every dispatch sets the lock, whatever its role — a non-gate agent arms the gate.

expectRed: logs a failed lock update and leaves the lock unset when pipeline.json is unreadable
mutations.note: A failed lock update is swallowed with no stderr signal.

expectRed: sets the lock beside the hook when git cannot resolve the repo
mutations.note: Without git, the root resolves to .claude/ — pipeline.json is not found and no dispatch sets the lock.
